scenes.title: Last Frontier
scenes.text: Eighty percent of our ocean remains unmapped and unseen. The deep is Earth's last frontier.

scenes.title: First Discovery
scenes.text: In eighteen seventy two, the Challenger expedition hauled up thousands of species no one had ever seen.

scenes.title: The Deepest Point
scenes.text: In nineteen sixty, two men descended to the deepest point on Earth, nearly eleven kilometers down.

scenes.title: Life Without Sun
scenes.text: Near boiling vents, life thrives without sunlight, feeding on chemicals from inside the planet.

scenes.title: Giant Squids
scenes.text: Giant squids, dismissed as sailor legends for centuries, finally turned out to be very real and truly enormous creatures.

scenes.title: New Species
scenes.text: A single deep dive can reveal more new species than a whole year on land.

scenes.title: Better Maps
scenes.text: We actually have far better detailed maps of Mars than of the ocean floor directly beneath our own feet.

scenes.title: Your Question
scenes.text: The deep holds answers to life's origins. What do you think is still hiding down there?
